correctness.rationale: PASS: For uniform spanning tree T of labelled K_{a,b}, sum of B-side degree excess is a−1, so at most a−1 B-vertices are nonleaves and removing all other B leaves gives a unique connected acyclic skeleton on A and the core. Conditional on this exact skeleton, all omitted B vertices attach independently and uniformly to one of a A-neighbors. For two independent trees, union of core B labels has size r<=2(a−1); the b−r double leaves contribute independent Bernoulli(1/a) overlaps, independent of all core overlap conditional on skeletons. For b>=2a−2 factor out Bin(b−2a+2,1/a) from every conditional PGF, leaving a mixture with nonnegative coefficients; maximal total overlap a+b−1 bounds residual degree by 3(a−1). For K_{3,n}, I/II skeleton types of a 3-star or two 2-stars are exhaustive. Enumeration by core sharing and edge overlap gives the stated Q_n(t) nonnegative correction polynomial, exact edge-disjoint ordered pair count and mean/variance. Independent direct tree enumeration matches full polynomial at n=4,5: 432 and 2025 spanning trees, 186624 and 4100625 ordered pairs, and zero-overlap counts 216 and 6480.
